title: cawg-test-suite plugin manifest (cawg-plugin.yml)
description: A conformance profile built on top of the CAWG profiles. Plugins may add statements, tighten CAWG warnings to failures and add validator cases; they may never weaken a CAWG statement. See docs/plugins.md.

name.description: Reverse-domain identifier of the plugin, e.g. org.example.music.

issuer.description: Issuer recorded in built rubrics (default: name).

requires.description: The cawg-test-suite versions this plugin works with, as a PEP 508 requirement, e.g. "cawg-test-suite>=0.2,<0.3".

statement_prefix.description: Category of every statement the plugin adds: statement IDs are <prefix>:<name>.

globals.description: Path to a YAML file with extra variables and expressions. The core globals are always available and cannot be redefined.

build_dir.description: Directory for built rubrics. When set, the tests require the committed rubrics to be up to date.

subjects.description: Extra validator-case subjects: name -> regular expression matched against status entry urls.

extends.description: Core profiles this profile builds on, e.g. cawg:metadata-1.1.

composables.description: YAML files with the plugin's own statements.

overrides.description: Core statement ID -> "fail". Only warnings can be overridden, and only to failures.

tests.description: Test configuration, shared by plugin manifests and the core cawg-tests.yml.

validator_cases.description: Glob patterns of validator case files.

assets_root.description: Directory of signed test assets that validator cases refer to.

crjson_root.description: Reference crJSON for the assets, with .rubric.json snapshots.

baseline.description: Known failures of the validator that produced crjson_root.

rubric_only_assets.description: Assets under assets_root that need no validator case.
